assessment: This manuscript provides fundamental new insight into protein conformational transitions underlying the transport mechanism of Nramps, an important and widespread transporter family that facilitates the uptake and movement of essential transition metals. Eight new crystallographic structures of the prokaryotic homolog DraNramp in a variety of ligand-bound and conformational states, along with companion molecular dynamics simulations and metal binding and transport assays, provide compelling evidence supporting most of the conclusions. These findings will be of broad interest to scientists studying transport mechanisms and ligand recognition.
